title: A registry conversation with CTF for families affected by LZTR1-related disorders

sentences.text: At RASopathies Network, we support families affected by LZTR1-related disorders.
The atlas infers a connection with Children's Tumor Foundation (CTF) through your support for schwannomatosis; this does not confirm coverage of every LZTR1-related condition.
LZTR1-related disorders and NF1 share a biological link: loss of gene function can weaken the cell's controls on RAS signals.

sections.heading: What already exists that we could share

sentences.text: CTF's NF Registry on the IAMRARE platform covers NF1 and all types of schwannomatosis.
PATRAS and the RASopathies Network contact registry are potential starting points, although their LZTR1 coverage is inferred by the atlas from syndrome coverage rather than explicit gene naming.
The Clinical, Genetic, and Epidemiologic Study of Children and Adults With RASopathies explicitly names LZTR1.
We propose sharing resource descriptions first, rather than assuming records can be combined.

sections.heading: What must be checked before we join forces

sentences.text: Please help confirm whether prominent corneal nerve fibers and fetal pleural effusion also occur in NF1.
We should also check abnormal coronary artery origin, and review all three features across SOS1- and PTPN11-related disorders rather than treating missing records as proof of absence.
The atlas's symptom-similarity links to SOS1 and PTPN11 are inferred and below 0.5 confidence, at 0.36 and 0.30 respectively.
Please confirm registry eligibility and practical reuse before we promise families shared access.
This month, let's send CTF one focused inquiry asking whether the NF Registry could include the wider range of LZTR1-related disorders and what eligibility checks would be needed.
No open questions are recorded yet in the supplied proposal input.
I am writing on behalf of RASopathies Network to explore a small collaboration.
Our community includes families affected by LZTR1-related disorders.
Could your NF Registry include the wider LZTR1 community?
Could we begin this month by clarifying eligibility and the differences that need checking?
[Your name], on behalf of RASopathies Network (RASopathiesNet USA / UK)
